BiblicalUsage: Peratsim is a mountain in Palestine, named for the breach. Isaiah says the LORD shall rise up as in Mount Perazim, to do His work, His strange work, and bring to pass His act, His strange act.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that God's strange work is still His work: He broke forth at Perazim against the Philistines, and He will break forth again.
